description.value: North End Farm is a small organic farm stand on Salt Spring Island offering fresh vegetables, fruits, meats, bread, pies, and treats, alongside products from other local island producers. It operates on a self-serve honour system — customers pay via cash box or e-transfer — making it a relaxed and characterful stop. For touring cyclists, it's a genuine source of fresh, local food in a community known for its agricultural identity.

address.value: 2521 North End Road, Salt Spring Island, V8K 1A5
